name: Twilight Moon Calling
source:
You meet a long-haired man named Hogan and a mysterious black-haired man named Rylan in town. They both claim it’s their first time visiting the town, but Hogan seems oddly familiar with the atmosphere of the place.

You speak with the town doctor, Cassius, and the priest, Laura. They warn that an outbreak has occurred in a nearby town and that this town might also be affected.
Feeling uneasy, you head home—but are suddenly attacked by an infected person who injects you with something.

Normally, infected people lose their sanity, yet this one seemed to be under someone’s control. Hogan and Rylan appear just in time, saving you and leading you to a safe place.
The three of you head to a nearby shelter, where Cassius is already treating survivors.
Cassius remarks that he has seen Hogan somewhere before.
You offer your blood for treatment, but strangely, it has no effect.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.vpandzscol]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你在镇上邂逅了蓄着长发的男子霍根与神秘的黑发男子莱兰。两人都声称自己是初次造访这座小镇，可霍根却对这里的氛围透着一股奇异的熟稔。

你与镇上的医生卡修斯及牧师劳拉交谈，得知邻镇爆发了疫情，而这座小镇恐怕也难以幸免。
你怀着不安踏上归途，却突遭一名感染者袭击，被对方在体内注射了某种药剂。

通常情况下，感染者都会丧失理智，可方才那人却仿佛受人操控。千钧一发之际，霍根与莱兰及时现身救下了你，并带你撤往安全地带。
你们三人赶往附近的避难所，卡修斯已在那里救治幸存者。
卡修斯提及自己似乎在哪儿见过霍根。
你主动献出自己的血液用于救治伤患，可奇怪的是，你的血却毫无效果。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.vpandzscol]Google Play[/url]]
